clause: Enhance — ML-adapter tier + re-editability lifecycle + receipts [STU-RAW-014b,STU-RAW-014c]

scope.summary: Implement the ML-model-backed Enhance tier (AI denoise, AI raw-details, AI super-resolution) ONLY as an optional StudioModelAdapter, local model preferred, no required cloud/account. When no adapter is installed the pipeline MUST fall back to the deterministic tier (MT-427) and surface a capability receipt rather than failing. An Enhance result MUST remain re-editable: an update/flatten lifecycle refreshes AI results when models change and flattens to a baked buffer with a documented reset path back to the editable state; every Enhance run MUST emit a receipt naming the adapter, the model identity, and whether it ran locally.
proof_targets: ML-adapter + no-adapter-degrade + re-edit lifecycle + receipt test
expected_tests: negative: no adapter -> falls back to deterministic tier + capability receipt (no failure)
test: Enhance result re-editable; update/flatten + reset path; run receipt names adapter+model+local-flag
acceptance_criteria_original: ML Enhance optional adapter; degrades to deterministic with receipt; re-editable update/flatten; run receipts

target_entries: Studio / Camera Raw & Develop / Enhance — AI (optional)

spec_clauses.spec_clause_text: **[STU-RAW-014]** Enhance operations MUST be split into the native deterministic tier and the optional model-adapter tier exactly as [STU-RAW-130] specifies. ### 17. Crop, Workflow Output, and Linkage to the Raster Document

**[STU-RAW-014b]** Masks MUST compose and manage: combine by add, subtract and intersect between any mask sources; invert, including duplicate-and-invert; duplicate, rename, hide and delete; a customizable mask overlay display; and a mask-local develop slider stack saveable as a local-adjustment preset re-applied with an amount control. Intersect and subtract semantics are the canonical `StudioMask` semantics of 14.23; the develop pipeline does not fork them.
See the assembled Master Spec; this anchor replaces a never-assigned citation.

implementation_notes.naming: Vendor product names are provenance only. Studio ships Handshake-native names per [STU-SECTION-003].
implementation_notes.database: SurrealDB with the EventLedger is the only durable authority. SQLite, libSQL, Turso and PostgreSQL are forbidden, including in tests and dev caches.
implementation_notes.engine_split: GPU, WGSL and compute live in the studio-engine crate behind its traits. handshake_core must never gain a GPU dependency.
implementation_notes.routing: Navigation extends the existing address and bus seams. No new router.
implementation_notes.worktree: Code paths resolve against the WP-KERNEL-012 worktree, never main.

validator_focus: Confirm every acceptance row traces to a sentence in the cited spec clause carried in implementation_notes. A row with no spec basis is a fabrication.
Reject any row still carrying proof_target_status REQUIRED: it has no proof of its own.
Reject scaffold-only proof: at least one proof command must drive the executable runtime rather than a fixture the implementer authored.
Where the contract touches numeric parameters, confirm hard and soft bounds are stored as separate values and an unknown bound is stored as unknown, never mirrored.

resource_privacy_obligation.rule: Resources this contract reads, derives, caches or exports stay inside the authenticated operator's scope. No cross-identity read path may be introduced.

patch_provenance.preserved: The original acceptance prose is kept verbatim at scope.acceptance_criteria_original. No clause, scope decision, path list or obligation from the original contract was removed.
